summary: 100-foot International Derrick lookout in Itawamba County, Mississippi, administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission; NHLR-registered July 2022; build date and staffing unknown.

facts.status_note: Last documented at a July 2022 site visit; no later source found.

events.note: Site visit recorded as 7/17/22 in the Register's description; the nominator is Jason Johns

evidence.supports: administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission
next entry in the Register's list is Dumas Lookout Tower (US 1684)

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the NHLR page is the only substantive source. The Forest Lookouts Fairview page has only a header (Mississippi Lookouts, Fairview, Itawamba County) and no text, so it is not cited. Searches on the Mississippi Forestry Commission and the Itawamba Historical Society archives returned no tower history. Build date, staffing, fire history, and current condition and access are not in any source read. The brief's elevation (167.6 m) matches the Register's 168 m. The brief had no height; the 100 ft figure comes from the Register's description. No photos added. Story is at the 120-word floor because the record is thin; the Register's next-entry link is the only added detail.
